---

name: Feature request
about: A new capability, argued as a decision before anything is built
title: "feat: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Decision

<!--
What is true today, and the call you are making: the current state, the choice, the date. If this
paragraph cannot name what is wrong with the tree as it stands, it is not a feature yet.
-->

## Spec

<!--
What changes, file by file or route by route. Name the field, the schema, the script, the fixture.
A spec a reviewer cannot check against the diff is a wish.
-->

## Must not

<!--
The boundaries: scope that belongs to another issue, files this may not touch, shortcuts this may
not take. A feature with no "must not" has not been scoped.
-->

## Acceptance

<!--
A command and its expected result — `bash scripts/verify.sh` exits 0, `gh issue view 41 --json
state` returns CLOSED. If it cannot be written as a command, it is not acceptance.
-->
